top_signals.title: StanChart Has Strong Capital Position, CEO Winters Says
top_signals.summary: Standard Chartered Chief Executive Officer Bill Winters says the bank is happy with earnings as results beat expectations. "We feel very, very good about the momentum that we've got," he tells Bloomberg's Lizzy Burden. Winters speaks on Bloomberg Television after the London-based lender unveiled a fresh $1 billion share buyback, adding that Standard Chartered has a "strong capital position." (Source: Bloomberg)
